concerns.text: The plan cites 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/GlobalCampus/openalex-multilingual-embeddings/...' as the source for 'id', 'title', 'cited_by_count', and 'author_ids'. This dataset name implies it contains pre-computed embeddings, not the raw graph topology (author IDs) or citation counts required to construct the collaboration network and calculate the bridging coefficient. If the dataset only contains embeddings, the plan cannot construct the 'author-based edges' described in 3.1 without a separate raw OpenAlex source. The cited dataset does not match the modality (raw graph metadata) required for the analysis.

The plan states: 'if the sampled Parquet lacks explicit edge lists, a k-NN graph based on title embedding similarity will be constructed'. This fallback changes the fundamental research question from 'topological bridging in collaboration networks' (based on co-authorship) to 'semantic bridging in text space'. The dataset cited (embeddings) supports the fallback but not the primary hypothesis. The plan must cite a source that actually provides the collaboration graph (e.g., OpenAlex raw works with author links) to validate the primary hypothesis, or explicitly reframe the study to semantic similarity only.
